answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges, fading each hop. An identity reached only by a long thin path earns little marble of standing; a fake cluster grafted on at the rim inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers who stake their own crystal-clear reputation. Minting a pearl-string of fakes with no real inbound edges buys no influence.
